real_name: David Coleman Headley (born Daood Sayed Gilani) — real name kept in film
real_life_notes: Pakistani-American LeT operative who conducted pre-attack reconnaissance of Mumbai targets for 26/11. Named 'Major Iqbal' as his ISI handler in FBI confessions. Pleaded guilty in Chicago in 2010; sentenced to 35 years in 2013. His confessions are the primary documented source linking ISI to 26/11 and naming specific handlers.
film_role: Headley's FBI confession is the documentary chain that establishes the 'Major Iqbal' character's existence. The film uses him as the evidence bridge between the ISI network and the on-screen intelligence operation.
objective: N/A — depicted in historical context, not as an active Film 2 adversary. His confession is the intelligence that validates the operation.
real_status: Serving 35-year sentence in US federal prison. Has given extensive depositions to Indian investigators via video conference.
oracle_note: Headley is not an active adversary in the film's timeline — his role is as the intelligence anchor that makes 'Major Iqbal' a traceable real target. His testimony is the VoI-maximising intelligence that opens up Major Iqbal's network.
